speaker: Elder Patricio M. Giuffra
title: Trusting the Lord Through Tithes and Offerings
session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

points.text: Elder Patricio M. Giuffra spoke about “Trusting the Lord Through Tithes and Offerings”.

quotes.text: When we began teaching the law of tithing and the promised blessings that come to those who obey it, with great sadness she said to me, “Elder Giuffra, I clean houses and wash clothes for several families. What I earn is barely enough to pay the rent for the room where we live, buy a small amount of firewood to keep us warm, and provide some food. I don’t think I will ever be able to live the law of tithing because I will not have enough money to do so.”
quotes.speaker: Elder Patricio M. Giuffra
quotes.talk: Trusting the Lord Through Tithes and Offerings
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: We were deeply moved. Everything she said made sense from a worldly perspective. Although we bore testimony of the great blessings the Lord promises to those who obey this commandment, she insisted that she could not do it.
quotes.speaker: Elder Patricio M. Giuffra
quotes.talk: Trusting the Lord Through Tithes and Offerings
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: President Caballero read to me the account of the widow’s mite and then said, “Elder Giuffra, you are no one to deny this sister the blessings of the law of tithing. There are no exceptions to this commandment.”
quotes.speaker: Elder Patricio M. Giuffra
quotes.talk: Trusting the Lord Through Tithes and Offerings
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: When we arrived at her home and began reviewing the lessons, we came once again to the law of tithing. She said to us, “Last night I knelt in prayer and told Heavenly Father that I truly wanted to become a member of His Church and that He would need to help me live this law.”
quotes.speaker: Elder Patricio M. Giuffra
quotes.talk: Trusting the Lord Through Tithes and Offerings
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: My wife often teaches a principle that has become very meaningful in our family: We keep the commandments because we love God, not merely because we hope to receive the blessings that come from obedience. Commandments are given to draw us closer to the Savior, to protect us, and to help us remain free from sin and many of the challenges the world presents.
quotes.speaker: Elder Patricio M. Giuffra
quotes.talk: Trusting the Lord Through Tithes and Offerings
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: This does not mean that we will be free from trials or difficulties. All of us will face moments of uncertainty, financial hardship, illness, or loss. Yet even when we do not understand the purpose of our trials, we can have the assurance that the Lord knows our circumstances, honors our obedience, and fulfills His promises in His own time and way.
quotes.speaker: Elder Patricio M. Giuffra
quotes.talk: Trusting the Lord Through Tithes and Offerings
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: “‘We preach tithing to the poor people of the world because the poor people of the world have had cycles of poverty, generation after generation,’ he said. ‘That same poverty continues from one generation to another, until people pay their tithing.’”
quotes.speaker: Elder Patricio M. Giuffra
quotes.talk: Trusting the Lord Through Tithes and Offerings
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: President Dallin H. Oaks taught: “The payment of tithing … brings the individual tithe payer unique spiritual blessings. Tithe paying is evidence that we accept the law of sacrifice. It also prepares us for the law of consecration and the other higher laws of the celestial kingdom.” These laws are fulfilled as we keep the covenants made in the house of the Lord, which deepens and perpetuates our relationship with Jesus Christ.
quotes.speaker: Elder Patricio M. Giuffra
quotes.talk: Trusting the Lord Through Tithes and Offerings
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference
